verified_semantics: AArch64 syntax accepted with Android clang target aarch64-linux-android34 and armv8.2-a.
Setup and read helpers receive timeout and mode-delay values selected from delay_mode.
Boot-config scan preserves the signed marker pair and computes max_offset from the recovered stock geometry.
Cursor alignment, zero-block search, rounded write length, +0x38 flash base and cleanup mode switch are present.
The write result is replaced by the rounded length only on non-negative stock write completion.
